output.review_comment: The agent correctly fixed three fundamental implementation bugs: (1) periods calculation now uses ceiling division to properly count started 30-day periods, (2) rounding now uses half-up instead of truncation, and (3) cap is applied before minimum to ensure minimum fee is always enforced. The docstring was properly updated to reflect the corrected logic. All changes follow standard algorithms and the implementation now passes all tests. The fixes align with the spec as encoded in the test suite.
